Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 82, verse 1:

﴿When the sky is split apart﴾ (inshaqqat), i.e., cleaves open.
And when the stars are scattered (inthatharat): they fall and drop down.
﴿And when the seas are made to burst forth﴾. Some of them were opened into others, so they became one sea, and the sweet water mixed with the salt.

﴿And when the graves are overturned﴾: their soil is turned over and their dead are raised. The response clause (*jawab*) of *idha* ("when") and what is conjoined to it (*ma 'utifa 'alayha*) [is as stated].

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 82, verse 5:

﴿Every soul will know﴾ i.e., every soul, at the time of the aforementioned events, which is the Day of Resurrection, ﴿what it has put forward﴾ of deeds ﴿and﴾ what it has ﴿left behind﴾ of them, so it did not do it.
O you who are man (the disbeliever), what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous, that you have disobeyed Him?

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 82, verse 7:

﴿Who created you﴾ after you were not, ﴿and proportioned you﴾ made you of sound form, with your limbs complete, ﴿and balanced you﴾ — with the variant readings of light and emphatic pronunciation (takhfif and tashdid) of the letters: made you of balanced creation, with your limbs in proportion, such that no hand or leg is longer than the other.

﴿In whatever form He willed, He assembled you﴾. Here "ما" (ma) is a ṣila (a connecting or extraneous particle, used to complete the phrase), and the clause "شاءَ رَكَّبَك" (shā'a rakkabak, "He willed, He assembled you") completes its meaning.

Translation of the passage:

﴿Nay!﴾ A rebuke against being deceived by the generosity of God, exalted is He. ﴿Rather, you deny﴾ i.e., the disbelievers of Mecca ﴿the Judgement﴾ i.e., the recompense for deeds.

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 82, verse 10:

﴿Indeed, over you are guardians,﴾ from among the angels, [recording] your deeds.

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 82, verse 12:

﴿They know what you do﴾ all of it.
Indeed the righteous (al-abrar), the believers sincere in their faith, are truly in bliss (na'im), that is, in Paradise.
And indeed the wicked (al-fujjar): the disbelievers, ﴿are surely in Hellfire﴾, a blazing fire.

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 82, verse 15:

﴿They will burn therein﴾ they will enter it and suffer its heat, ﴿on the Day of Judgment﴾ the Recompense.

Translation:

﴿And they will not be absent from it﴾ — meaning: "not ones who will be removed from it" (بِمُخْرَجِينَ).

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 82, verse 17:

﴿And what will make you know what the Day of Judgment is?﴾ (He) informed you: "What is the Day of Judgment?"
Then what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is? (This is) a magnification of its matter.

Commentary of al-Mahalli and al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 82, verse 19:

﴿Yawm﴾ is in the nominative case (bi'l-raf'), meaning: it is a day ﴿on which no soul will have power to do anything for another soul﴾ of benefit, ﴿and the command on that day belongs to Allah﴾, there being no command for anyone else in it; that is, He does not permit anyone to intercede in it, unlike in this world.
